name: Parametric modelling
summary: Form generated by a model of rules and parameters, so that a change to one value updates the whole geometry.
how: Drive the geometry from 3 to 10 named parameters, not from drawn lines.
Vary each facade panel by a field value; no two panels need to be equal.
Keep the curvature continuous between the surfaces.

origin.note: The office of Frank Gehry uses CATIA, a tool from aircraft design, to model and build the Fish sculpture in Barcelona.

adoptions.via: Patrik Schumacher names Parametricism at the Venice Architecture Biennale; Zaha Hadid Architects scripts whole facades.

sources.title: Patrik Schumacher, The Autopoiesis of Architecture (2011)
